release_notes:
• Scrubber: instant, safe seeking — a failed stream seek now falls back automatically to the download route at exactly the position you picked
• Seeking no longer risks silence: the old voice keeps playing until the new one is live
• Update prompt: tapping LATER no longer re-opens on every return to the app
• The analyser (FFT / wave) is back on the Now Playing screen with your saved mode
• Credit & welcome page appears only on a first install
• Bigger featured-hit poster cards on Home
